name: nfd-tolerance-corpus
description: Standalone corpus harness for the NFC/NFD context-tolerance transform (spec 062). Runs the real transform over every keyboard in the sibling keymanapp/keyboards checkout, recompiles and re-simulates the result, and buckets each keyboard by measured OUTCOME - no gap, gap fixed, gap remaining, regressed/corrupted, failed to compile, refused by a named internal gate. Measures input equivalence only; it never proposes a change to what a keyboard outputs. Not a packages/* member and deliberately outside `pnpm -r`.
